description: An AFTER phrase in an inline PERFORM — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 91: "PERFORM statement. The AFTER phrase is allowed in an inline PERFORM." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitPerformVaryingAfter (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
display: an AFTER phrase in an inline PERFORM
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.47 - the 2002 Annex F.2 relaxations of COBOL-85 restrictions (item 91)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMIPA.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 I PIC 9.
01 J PIC 9.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > 2
            AFTER J FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL J > 2
        DISPLAY I J
    END-PERFORM.
    STOP RUN.
